author: beriaacan
body:
#### PR description:
Add backend `crate` mapping to support HGCal time-jump emulation:
- Added `crate` column to module-parameter SoA and stored it in `HGCalFEDReadoutSequence` via `processNewModule`.
- Added `HGCalMappingModuleIndexer::uniqueCrates()` to return distinct crate IDs.
- Defaults to `1` when the module locator lacks a `crate` column (backward-compatible, no reco output changes).

#### PR validation:
- Built in `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5` (`el9_amd64_gcc14`).
- Ran `cmsRun Geometry/HGCalMapping/test/testMappingModuleIndexer_cfg.py`: job exited 0, correctly defaulted to `crate=1` (FED 0/1), and returned a single unique crate (`{1}`).
title: Record the BE crate of each Slink in the HGCal module map.
